t: Man, that "Servant of Tensess" fella is one tough cookie! Or is it just that I lost my form after years without a good fight? No worries, methinks I'll need to recall my glorious past soon enough!

At first, when you spoke about a meeting with the Servant of Tensess, I admit I did not believe it. But why would you want to deceive me? So I decided to rouse the enemy, compel them to make mistakes and reveal themselves. The plan worked perfectly.
When I gave the order to speed up construction by revving up the generators to maximum power, that's when that sanctimonious fool had to personally intervene to prevent us from completing the construction. So I caught him red-handed and gave him a glorious thrashing! Sparks everywhere! But his strength seemed inexhaustible, and in your world, alas, I am burdened by certain limitations. So, to be frank, that exploding generator did right by both of us when it interrupted your flight.
Now our enemy is defeated and fled in fear. Moreover, he lost a fair amount of his power, which was absorbed into the Cradle, strengthening it.
And I strongly advise that you forget about the meeting with the Servant of Tensess, the duel and everything else. No one can know about it. Believe me, if you wind up in the Purgatory again, he will pretend that he doesn't know you at all. You are but a grain of sand to him, your life - a moment in time before eyes of eternity. What happened is not your problem, not at all. It isn't even your world's problem, my friend. Your problem is Sarn, and that's what you ought to focus on if you wish to survive. And forget about today's duel.
Collect the Frosty Artifact and the Frozen Artifact and bring them to the Worn June Obelisk.

It's difficult to make out what's on the stone - it has been severely eroded from the brutal elements. However, you can clearly make out the figure of a hunter battling a winged beast.
Perhaps this marks the path to Yad-Volk's grave! You should follow the trail and collect any other clues along the way. Anything related to the June warrior might come in useful later.
This obelisk matches the one near the Gibberlings! It appears to have two small holes in it, as if something is meant to fit inside them...
Placing the artifacts in the obelisk causes a strange glow to emanate from the icy tomb nearby... You should be careful, anything could happen now!
Discover the fates of Atis, Amis, and Potisa and return to Ivok.

Hey there! Who am I? I'm possibly the last one flyin' from a merchants' expedition that went haywire. There were originally four of us merchants. We heard that this allod contained some rare 'shrooms which sell for a pretty coin on the black market.
My botanist mate and I stayed behind while my three comrades - Atis, Amis, and Potisa - went in search of the fungi gold mine. We heard some terrible screams from way off in the woods while we waited, and I fear the worst has happened...
I just wanna find my friends and get outta here now. This place gives me the creeps. A group of fellow merchants are gonna arrive in a couple hours to take us off the allod. Could ya lend a hand and find what became of my friends before we have to leave?
We were known as the Fantastic Four! Yes, we used to be this...
It appears my comrades didn't make it out alive. I'll carry their rings with me in memory of 'em. Thank ya.
Explore Wolf Island and kill 6 Fierce Werewolves and Vseslav the Charming, the leader of the pack. Then report back to Fedor Stablemanov.

During my travels I try to keep away from the Wolf Island. There is an old legend about this sinister place. It tells about Kanian village that became a feeder for a werewolf.
A long, long time ago Kanian druid Vseslav the Charming became so close to the wolves from the island that he learned how to transform into one. He became their leader, and his neighbors turned his first victim. After a while the whole island had been infested with wolves and werewolves. Unlucky travelers who ventured to the island were eaten by predators. Everyone is trying to avoid it. Who wants to be torn apart by predators or even worse, to be transformed into a werewolf?
If you want to perform a feat, you should go to the Wolf Island. But remember! As you step on the wolves' land, you will be risking your life every second. Think it well before you challenge the pack!

Wolf Island could be a great camping site for the moments of rest between my expeditions.
If not for werewolves...

Have you managed to do it?
There are very few adventurers brave enough to challenge the pack...
I am proud to be your friend!
Explore Wolf Island and kill 6 Fierce Werewolves and Vseslav the Charming, the leader of the pack. Then report back to Afanasy Nikitov.

During my travels I try to keep away from the Wolf Island. There is an old legend about this sinister place. It tells about Kanian village that became a feeder for a werewolf.
A long, long time ago Kanian druid Vseslav the Charming became so close to the wolves from the island that he learned how to transform into one. He became their leader, and his neighbors turned his first victim. After a while the whole island had been infested with wolves and werewolves. Unlucky travelers who ventured to the island were eaten by predators. Everyone is trying to avoid it. Who wants to be torn apart by predators or even worse, to be transformed into a werewolf?
If you want to perform a feat, you should go to the Wolf Island. But remember! As you step on the wolves' land, you will be risking your life every second. Think it well before you challenge the pack!

Wolf Island could be a great camping site for the moments of rest between my expeditions.
If not for werewolves...

Have you managed to do it?
There are very few adventurers brave enough to challenge the pack...
I am proud to be your friend!
Kill 5 Monstrous Trolls and Kirth Foulfoot and return to Tristan de Doucer.

What is it? What do you want? Are you here to accuse my family of involvement with the vampires? Here to slaughter us, perhaps? Or maybe... you're here to help?
You see, we fled Kania to get away from the prejudice. Everyone expects us to be traitors just because we're from the House de Doucer. We seek to start a new life, away from the poison of Armando.
The mains thing that prevents us from achieving absolute solace are the hostile creatures that inhabit this allod. Our mages created a magical barrier, but it's only a matter of time before the trolls shatter our defenses. No matter how much we drive them away, they keep coming back.
The only way to defeat the trolls is to take out their warlord, Kirth Foulfoot. Then and only then will we be able to live in peace. Please kill him and as many trolls as you can!
I cannot completely trust you until the trolls are destroyed!
I'm glad I was wrong about you. Your service gives my family hope for survival and a new life.
Kill 12 Mantis Fighters and 12 Mantis Sorcerers and report back to Robert de Doucer.

Welcome, stranger.
In front of you there are weary but hopeful fugitives. Do you know the story of my family? Most of the Elves from the House de Doucer followed Armando. They accepted Tep's gift and became horrible vampires. We, however, rejected that path.
We hope to one day restore the glory of our house. Even your acceptance of us is a good sign. While my relatives may view you with suspicion, deep down they are hoping to gain new allies.
Please help us protect our new home. It would really help if you could kill some of the mantises that inhabit this allod. The Elves from the House de Doucer would be forever grateful.
Forgive my friend Tristan, for he is less trusting of members outside of our family. However, I have high hopes for you. Please do not disappoint my expectations!
Thank you. Today may be a turning point for my family!
Defeat Sikolo the Cursed and inform Eliott de Doucer of your success.

Hello adventurer. I'm the Great Mage Tristan de Doucer. Yes, I am young and not as strong as the cursed Armando, but I have worked hard so my family can call this allod our home. Almost all of my energy is spent protecting this allod from the onset of the Astral and keeping up our magical shields.
You may be familiar with the mantises and the trolls that trouble us on a daily basis. However, they are nothing compared to the lizardmen that live to the northeast of here. They're led by a horrible undead creature named Sikolo the Cursed.
When we first arrived at the allod, every guard that we sent to scout the northern section never returned. I later ordered a small band of scouts to check out the woods for signs of our fallen comrades. It was then that we discovered the lizardmen's camp.
This creature needs to be destroyed. He is just as evil as Armando himself. I would like to destroy the creature myself but I must use my energy to protect this village at all times. If you want to help us, please seek out Sikolo the Cursed and destroy him!
The survival of my family rests in your hands. You can help or simply give up, dooming us to extinction...
I wasn't wrong about you! I can already feel the evil energy starting to dissipate... My family will forever be grateful!
Kill Smasher the Rowdy and report back to David Tamirov.

Why hello! We are honorable Free Traders and we wish you no harm. We came to this allod while searching for the headquarters of a bunch of nasty smugglers. The good news is that we found them. The bad news is that they destroyed our ship and most of our comrades.
Those damn thieves make our lives so difficult! They're constantly ruining our reputation. Can you believe that ordinary people see little difference between us and the smugglers? What an outrage!
We wanted to strike at the heart of their miserable little operation once we found our lair, but it seems that we won't be able to proceed as planned.
Do you think you could help us finish this mission? If you could kill their leader, the rest of the smugglers would be like a flock of lost sheep. Please take out the one named Smasher the Rowdy - the big Orc in the heart of their camp.
You can find a picture of Smasher's smiling face on many boxes of smuggled goods in both Nezebgrad and Novograd. That's his little mark, the bastard!
Well done. Thank you for giving them what they deserve!
Collect 12 pieces of Glowing Meteorite Ore and bring them to the Earthy Family.

You're not a smuggler, right? Good, we didn't think so. You see, in the middle of this allod is some smugglers' camp. We are some mercenaries that the Free Traders hired to help them wipe the smugglers out.
You see, the smugglers cause a lot of trouble for the Free Traders. Their methods lead to unfair prices and unpaid taxes. They're a blight on Sarnaut!
We lost most of our forces in a battle with the smugglers a few days ago, but we haven't given up hope! We were hired to destroy the smugglers and that's what we'll do!
We came up with a little plan and we were hoping you could help us with it. You see, the smugglers don't have a Great Mage here. They keep the allod protected with boxes of meteorite ore. If we take them away, the allod will be destroyed. With their headquarters gone, they'll be crippled!
Go collect as much meteorite ore as possible. After we collect it all, we'll sail away with the band of reinforcements that should soon come for us. Then this job will be complete!
Once we capture the meteorite ore the allod will vanish!
Great! This will all be over as soon as our ship arrives. Thanks for your help!
Use the Mental Detector at the Zem ruins to the west to locate Sarang Khamudi.

The demons attacked swiftly. They destroyed our communication lines and cut us off from the port. The Astral fangs then destroyed half of our base!
After rallying our forces we were able to repel their attack, and we even began a counterattack! Now our scientists are trying to find a way to rid the allod of the Astral fangs.
There's only one thing that worries me. We believe that one of our scientists is an accomplice of the demons. He's hiding near the ancient Zem ruins to the west, but he used an invisibility spell to cloak himself.
Take this device. It detects brainwaves, and those are things that cannot be hidden. Once you detect his presence, his invisibility spell should fade and you'll be able to apprehend him!
What? You can see me? How is that possible!
Don't kill me! I did nothing wrong!
Kill the demons controlling the Stranded Scientists and return to Sarang Khamudi.

I am Sarang Khamudi. I used to be one of the head scientists at this facility. We were researching some of the nearby Zem ruins, but a few days ago an invisible demon attacked me! It tried to take control of my mind.
Oh, they knew not who they had come across! I am a skilled psionicist, you see. I managed to subdue the creature and look into its mind. This revealed the fact that the demons are here for the Empire's top secret information, it's our Tep's inheritage.
Their chief is dead now. The rest of the gang is still as threatening as it was, for they're able to squeeze the information even out of the dead.
I've altered this device to detect the invisible demons that are controlling the dead soldiers. Go to the West of the island. Kill the monsters and return to me once the allod and the secret it is hiding are safe.
Hurry, every minute you wait brings the demons closer to accessing the information!

Good job! The demons' plans have been completely ruined. Here, take this documents - I sense they could help you in your future travels. I can see into your mind, and I trust that you will keep this information safe.
Go to the Imperial base on the Hikut Shard and find someone who can explain the situation.

The demons are everywhere, trying to penetrate into my soul! Don't trust anyone, I tell you! Okay? You should leave immediately. There's no one left to save anyway... everyone's dead...
Above all, don't go near those horrible ruins near the Imperial base! That's the source of the evil, okay? You'll just be going to your own doom. Now run, run as fast as you can!

He said that everyone was dead, and that demons were penetrating his soul? Poor Feodor seems to have lost his mind... Anyway, we do have some problems that we need help with, but none are that grave, though.
Defeat 36 Bone Warriors and receive your well-earned ticket to the world of fantasy from Professor Mainus.

World of fantasy is delightful and sweet... But you won't get there without my help, hehe.
If you want to plunge into your deepest wishes, you must help me first.
The dead raised from their graves at the cemetery not far from here. They don't bother me much, except for the noise they make with their dry bones. It really drives me crazy!
Put these bone warriors back to their graves, and I'll give you the ticket to the Fantasy.
Be aware of Arisen Enchanters - if they manage to breathe supernatural powers into nearby Bone Warriors, your death is imminent.
I am fed up with these rattling bones. Their rumbling and crunching distract me...

So, these walking skeletons are finally put to rest!
You fulfilled my wish, and I'm fulfilling yours. I'm granting you the ticket to the fantasy land!
Kill 5 Arisen Necromancers at the cemetery and return to Professor Mainus.

Damn it! Some magical perturbations cause disorder to my navigational devices. Where are they coming from?
Oh, I know. These Arisen Necromancers are messing around, their pathetic sorcery is like a grain of sand in my fragile mechanism. So disgusting!
Do you want to travel to the fantasy world? Grind to dust five Arisen Necromancers, and I will help you.
Although necromancers look like easy targets, skeleton crowds they raise may become a serious trouble. Be careful!
You have to earn your ticket to the fantasy world!

Well, well. Necromancers are below ground, and my devices are working perfectly fine.
You deserved this ticket to the land of fantasy!
Defeat 15 Drowned Corpses and return to Professor Mainus.

One must find their own way to the fantasy world. For a child, it would be a wide road paved with yellow bricks, while the adult would have to travel over a narrow path across a deadly swamp.
I will help you to find your dreams, for a price of course.
You must dispose of 20 Drowned Corpses. These vile creatures are poisoning the water in the stream.
Remember that the corpses still have some remnants of mind. If you kill one of them, it will enrage the others.
Well, do you want to travel to the fantasy land? You will have to work hard then.
What a disgusting smell! You stink like rot and damp. I believe you have completed my request. Now you can safely travel to the fantasy world!
Defeat 5 Nightmare Shadows and return to Professor Lextor.

Do you want to travel to the fantasy world? It's easy! Just close your eyes, forget your useless thoughts and set your imagination loose!
Did it work? No? I knew it.
You see, in the world of adults, there is a huge problem with fantasizing! All life is scheduled in advance... there is little time for imagination.
But I'm an expert in the field of fantasy. And if I can't awaken your imagination, nobody can.
Of course, my help will cost you something. Nightmare Shadows settled in the old ruins to the west are the reason why you are waking up in the middle of the night. And not you alone...
Kill five of these creatures, and nothing will stand between you and the fantasy world.
Nightmares destroy fantasies... and your aim is to destroy the nightmares!
Phew... Now I can sleep well and you can safely travel to the fantasy world.
Defeat 8 Arisen Enchanters and 8 Cursed Warriors, then return to Professor Lextor.

Fantasy... Fantasy makes this world so amazing. Without imagination, we are all doomed to stagnate.
Today you have a chance to travel to the wonderful world of fantasy! Help me to deal with the undead settled in the ruins to the west, defeat 8 Arisen Enchanters and 8 Cursed Warriors, and I will show you the way to this beautiful world!

You are nobody's fool! Who else would risk their life battling the vile undead for the sake of fantasies?
The fantasy world is open for you!
Kill 4 Harbingers of Nightmares and return to Professor Lextor.

Wait, wait... I'm busy!
What's there? Do you want to travel to the world of living fantasy? Aren't you afraid? Playing with imagination may be dangerous... I can help you, but you must pass my test first.
Harbingers of Nightmares, nasty creatures settled in the ruins to the west, are chasing the dreamers, hovering around them and forcing them to scream in their sleep. They can even bewitch some of the sleepers, stealing their minds and subduing their will. They will easily sacrifice lives of their minions in case of a danger, increasing their own strength.
Can you imagine what a dangerous enemy you are going to fight? Kill four Harbingers of Nightmares, and I will show you the way to the fantasy.
Nightmares inhabiting this island prevent me from catching the... Nevermind. They just annoy me.

Well done! They will forget the way here for good.
You deserved the ticket to your innermost fantasy!
Defeat 5 Cursed Soldiers and return to Professor Yvish.

I bet you are dreaming of a long life and valorous death in the end, like all heroes? Worthy fantasies.
The soldiers who died here long ago were dreaming of that, too. But their dreams never fulfilled. They turned into terrifying zombies, now wandering to the northwest from here.
Give rest to the souls of five Cursed Soldiers, fulfill their dreams of peace, and I will send you to the fantasy land.
The nature of this curse is very interesting... But this is a topic for a scientific paper, not a hasty conversation.

Have you put the soldiers to rest? Excellent!
Do you still want to go to the fantasy land? Then what are we waiting for? Let's go!
Kill 3 Twilight Shadows and return to Professor Yvish.

Have you ever been to the Dead Wood? Aura of despair surrounds the piles of bones and dried trees... Twilight Shadows hiding there bring dead melancholy to a traveler foolish enough to step into this dark place.
Dispose of five shadows to make the wood a safer place! The shadows are not visible to the naked eye, but I will teach you a spell allowing to uncover them in the gloom. If you help me, I'll send you to the very innermost of your fantasies!
This forest is terrifying... I would never risk my life going there.
You are not easily frightened! The fantasy awaits you, my friend. Let's go!
Defeat 8 Rotting Corpses and return to Professor Yvish.

Dead Wood was once a green and peaceful forest, but some evil force infected it with a terrible curse. Not only it turned the trees to rot... The unfortunate travelers who die in the Dead Wood are raised as zombies, spreading the infection further...
Listen, if you want to travel to the fantasy land, I will need your help. Defeat five Rotting Corpses, and the way to the fantasy will be open.
I'm checking my ration - hopefully it's not rotten...

Already done? You know, I believe you. Your part is complete, now it's my turn.
Welcome to the land of fantasy!
Save Kir Buran, stop construction in the Mechanoids' Lair and report to Alice Bullicheva.

Thank you for saving me! If I would have been captured, I wouldn't be able to save captain Kir!
I wonder where they're holding him. And what's going on in this island? I'm sure Buran was able to find out something. Please, help me rescue him!
Oh, I do not like it!
I am grateful to you for destroying another lair of Tep's followers!
Start Genesis and talk to the Integral.

The Priests call me heretic. This is a mistake, it's them who are heretics. We are Tep's servants who have failed. We didn't want war. We escaped to build our own world of mechanisms, without necromancy or Nihil. The Priests came with us and helped us with the phase one: building the Integral. I was to take care of the phase two, the Genesis, that would have given birth to the godly supercreation. System error. Process was interrupted. They locked me in here. Now they control the Integral and my brothers' machinery. All they need is power. Uninstall priests. Initiate Genesis. The machines never forget the good.
As soon as you deactivate the protection system, you will be able either to destroy it or start Genesis. This will be your own choice. I have no rational reason to let you go.
Was it what you call mercy? You don't seem to have had any rational reason for such a decision. Go now. The Integral must make some calulations to comprehend what has just happened.

There were big changes for those who like to try various roles.

For instance, the Impression is no longer needed! The class trainer may now restore your memory and return the lost soul to the right path.

Talk to your class trainer to learn more.

Now you may return to the saved class at any time. Just talk to one of us to do so.

If you ever change your mind, you can always purchase the Memory Stamp.
Every class trainer can sell you one. Use it to save your current class as default. Voila, now you can return to your default class anytime.

Fight in the Battle for Ambrosia, participate in capturing a Source, and kill 5 enemies.

Report to Waterlily afterwards.

Child of Sarn, I'm beginning to trust you. You have proven that you are truly on our side.

When the forest first met you, it began to defend itself. Thorns rose from the ground, poisonous spores filled the air. The forest rejected you like parasites.

If you want to be a part of it, go ahead and show that you are a new thorn. Deadly and strong.

The Children of Sarn are great warriors. Like Sarn himself who protected the All-Mother from all threats!

My people have a lot to learn from people like you.

And we have something to teach you.

Here - take a look!
Fight in the Battle for Ambrosia and trap three opponents.

Child of Sarn, the forces of the Expedition are heavily armed, but we have something we can use against them.

The forest has accepted you. Now you need to learn how to use the enemy's power against them.

Tenacious roots, poisonous spores, and deadly thorns are the natural defenses of Eden. Now you can call on some of that power to help you.

Use traps against enemies.

You can learn about other types of traps from me.

Now I want you to learn how to deal with poison spitters.
Fight in the Battle for Ambrosia; participate in capturing a Source and killing 5 enemies. Report to Yasskul Addaya afterwards.

I'm glad you're on our side! It's time to punch these natives so they know they can't stop us from getting what we want.

Now the real fight begins. And as you already know, some of our "heroes" turned out to be traitors and defected to the side of the All-Mother. There is nothing worse than traitors. The Children are at least honest. And traitors deserve only one response!

While you're doing this combat mission, teach them what patriotism means. Maybe they will come to their senses.

Sarnaut's technology has proven its worth in this world. But we still have something to surprise those who are trying to resist us.

If you want to win, you must study military science.  I will help you.

Take a look at what we have in our arsenal.
Fight in the Battle for Ambrosia and trap three opponents.

These Children have some curious means of warfare, but we have our own answer to that.

Sarnaut has been at war for thousands of years, and we have strategies our enemies can't even imagine.

All is fair in war. Use traps. Learn new ones. And look around carefully - the natives are also preparing unpleasant surprises for us.

Not bad. I recommend mastering the Deathtrap as soon as possible.

 In addition, I give you clearance to use the turrets. A powerful thing. Try it, and you will thank our engineers.
We are the children of progress People once fought with sticks and stones, now we have weapons that can affect even gods.
Ask Rhubarb about the battles in the Ambrosia Valley.

Before you is the great Ambrosia Valley, the very heart of our home. It is guarded by the mighty guardian of the forest - Cypress, and we strive to provide him with support.

The power of our All-Mother flows freely in places of power, and they can be controlled.

If the Valley falls, the Great Tree is doomed. We can't let it happen!

You want to know how we plan to protect it? Ask me.
The outcome of this war depends on your actions. The more Ambrosia the enemy gets, the stronger they become.
Ask Felix about the battles in the Ambrosia Valley.

Before you is the so-called Ambrosia Valley, the very heart of our enemy's domain. It's guarded by a strong Treant, Cypress. We need to destroy this creature.

The power of this goddess, the All-Mother, flows freely in places of power, and they can be controlled.

If the Valley falls, then the Children will have no choice but to recognize our victory. So do everything you can.

You want to know our plan of attack? Ask me.
The outcome of this war depends on your actions. The more Ambrosia we get, the sooner we win the day.

We have to do something. And we will!

I told you the aliens can't be trusted. At least the ones left at this base.

Darkness has long swallowed their souls, and there's only one thing we can do...

The valley will not rest while the children of Sarn are here.

Go and drive them away.

The flowers in the Valley will be thoroughly fertilized.

Here is your reward, outlander.
Fight in the Battle for Ambrosia, earn at least 500 points, and participate in killing at least 5 enemies.

We have to do something. And we will!

I told you the savages can't be trusted.

But you decided to befriend them. And look what happened!

We're not leaving here until we get the Ambrosia. We have no right to let our homeland down.

Go to the valley and force the natives to give us the source.

Good. We will be consistent and persistent, and we will get what Sarnaut needs to survive.

Here's your pay.
Learn the cycle of elements in combat.

I assume you already know about the existence of elemental entities such as fire, water, air, earth...

These are the building blocks of the universe, the foundation of all worlds. They manifest themselves in everything that's burning, flowing, blowing, and in solid things... Warm, cold, wet and dry...

Finally, in winter, spring, summer, and fall.

The cycle is endless because it has no beginning and no end.  See for yourself.
You need to understand the nature of the cycle...

So you've learned your first lesson. Elemental powers are everywhere, and they are extremely important. In your destroyed world, seasons barely change, but in those worlds that were properly created, they always do.

Perhaps eventually you will meet my Children, the masters of the elements. Each of them has its own world, and each has many followers endowed with the same powers. There are similar entities in your world.
Learn the cycle of elements in combat at the roots of the Great Tree

I want you to repeat my lesson.

You already know about the existence of elemental entities such as fire, water, air, earth...

These are the building blocks of the universe, the foundation of all worlds. They manifest themselves in everything that's burning, flowing, blowing, and in solid things... Warm, cold, wet and dry...

Finally, in winter, spring, summer, and fall.

The cycle is endless because it has no beginning and no end.  See for yourself.

Go and learn this lesson again!
You need to understand the nature of the cycle...
You have learned this lesson. To understand the true meaning of my words, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.
Understand the circle of life by going through the plant, herbivore, and carnivore stages.

Everything you see is interconnected and balanced. Everything serves what was before and what comes after. Everything is necessary.

Grass grows in a clearing, Strantlers eat it, Strantlers fall prey to predators, and when they die, they themselves become grass.

Everything is interconnected. You will learn this lesson.
Do you understand the essence of the Circle of Life?

As you can see, death is part of the cycle, just like life. Without death there is no life, so universal immortality would become the final death of all living things. I hope you can remember this simple truth.
Understand the circle of life at the roots of the Great Tree by going through the plant, herbivore, and carnivore stages.

I want you to repeat my lesson.

Everything you see is interconnected and balanced. Everything serves what was before and what comes after. Everything is necessary.

Grass grows in a clearing, Strantlers eat it, Strantlers fall prey to predators, and when they die, they themselves become grass.

Everything is interconnected. Death is part of the cycle, just like life. Without death there is no life, so universal immortality would become the final death of all living things.

Go and learn this lesson again!
Do you understand the essence of the Circle of Life?
You have learned this lesson. To understand the true meaning of my words, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.

This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.

But you are not ready to see them yet.

All that has been created will perish.

All that has perished will be recreated.

The existence is a great circle. There is no creation without destruction. There is no destruction without creation.

The circle has no beginning or end.

The divine couple has always existed. All-Mother and Father Time. I, All-Mother, is the goddess of life and creation. Father Time is the god of death and destruction. Together we led our worlds through the cycles of births and deaths. We created and destroyed.

We were not alone. Our passion gave birth to our divine children, subject to us. Each of them played their own role. Each of them obeyed the common laws. There were twelve Domains in my hierarchy. Each Domain was responsible for a single power. Each Domain had a master.

Only I, All-Mother, the goddess of creation, and my divine husband, Father Time, the god of destruction, were eternal Lords of our Domains. Other gods were immortal and lived very long lives, which ultimately had to be over. The circle has always spun, and gods were destined to die.

Many years have passed.
Ask the Children about their legends and traditions.

Listen, I have a suggestion for you - we ended up here in a completely new world, and I think the best way to negotiate with its inhabitants is to understand how they live.

I suggest you interview them and see what they have to say about their culture. I'm sure that if we know more about them, we'll be able to find common ground with them.

You should speak with the Children with different occupations. So your observations will be more complete. Trust me, I'm an experienced spy and scout.

Well, a lot of things are starting to make sense now. It's a unique culture that has no match anywhere in Sarnaut. But at the same time, I understand that their way of life is contrary to the goals pursued by Felix and Catherina. I wonder if we can still come to an understanding?
Greetings! Remember, the forest can be dangerous...
Fight the Children to see who is stronger.

Talking about it won't get us anywhere.

Do you know what my first goblinball coach told me? "If you want to understand someone, punch them in the face!"

These Children are big guys, but we've dealt with worse. Maybe you'll fight them? Then make up.

No, I'm serious. We need to understand what they are about. I suggest we challenge those who consider themselves warriors.  Choose someone strong. The girl who dragged us here looks like a twig.

Wow, you are strong, can't argue with that. Alright, they seem to be good guys. I'm starting to understand them: we came here uninvited and made a mess. Yes, but how can we explain this to our people?
Fight the warriors of the Children on the branches of the Great Tree

Your world has known many wars, but Eden was a peaceful place before you arrived. That is why there are almost no warriors like you among us. However, thanks to the wisdom of the All-Mother, we are learning quickly, and I think we will soon be able to fight back against the invaders.

Of course, this requires training, and warriors have already begun training hunters from our tribes. But the Rhubarb's warriors have much to learn from you. So I ask you to give them a few more lessons.
As you can see, my people are adapting quickly. We grow thorns and claws, and soon the hour will come when Eden will get rid of the arrogant aliens stealing the ambrosia!
You wear a hard shell, but your bark underneath is quite soft.  We are stronger than you on the inside.
Fight the warriors of the Children on the branches of the Great Tree

Child of another world, you were molded by a different culture, and I still can't understand what Sarn expected from you.

However, you must not disparage the warriors of Eden, because from the moment you arrived in our world, they have been constantly growing and changing. This is my gift to them, and now all of Eden must become stronger.

You can help me. I think we could learn a lot from each other.

Three of our strongest warriors are impressed by your abilities. They are ready to challenge you again!

If you ready to accept the challenge, go fight them in a training duel!
As we grow, we only get stronger. It is in my power to give them thorns, and it is in your power to teach them how to use them.

Yes, my Children grow stronger every day. Their bark will not be pierced by machine blades, and their sap will poison anyone who encroaches on Eden. To better understand my lesson, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.
Help Caraway collect the fruits of the Great Tree and deal with Chamomile's problem.

It used to be easier to take care of fruits. Now... the animals are more aggressive, and you, invaders, are not making our lives any easier. I hope we manage to keep all the new Children.

We need all the help we can get, and we'd like to get things done faster. If the All-Mother trusts you, then so do I.

I'll ask a favor of you - Caraway is in charge of collecting fruits east of the Great Tree, but he still hasn't returned. Find him and provide help if he needs it.
Well, what are you waiting for?

Excellent. I guess you can be trusted. Each fruit is precious, because no one knows who will become a new Great Tree.

We believe that our Sparks, and the Sparks of everyone who got to Eden, are reborn in new Children, but only our Creator knows whether this is true.
Help Caraway collect the fruits of the Great Tree at the Blossoming Riverbed

Greetings. May my Blessing be with you!

My Children's lives used to be simple, but now... we're facing a lot of problems, and I want to ask you for help.

I'm talking about collecting the fruits of the Great Tree. I've been told that you have helped our fruit pickers and keepers, so I will ask you to do it again today.

Caraway is in charge of picking fruit, you can find him to the east from the Great Tree. Find him and provide help if he needs it.
You need to collect the fruits as quickly as possible!
Thank you for your help. I see Waterlily was right to vouch for you. I'll have another task for you tomorrow, be sure to come back and talk to me.
Harvest Ripe Ambrosia Blossoms and Hungry Strantler Sap at Blossoming Riverbed.

I have a job for you. Will you help us?

The thing is, we've been having problems because of your Expedition. There are other reasons, too.

Animals started migrating, which means there are too many of them in one place, and too few in another.

And now Ambrosia is ready to be harvested at Blossoming Riverbed near the roots of the Great Tree.

Alas, the frightened Strantlers moved closer to the Great Tree, and now all blossoms are at risk.

We need to harvest them before the animals eat them. And hunt for the Strantlers while you're at it so we have something other than the fruits. It would also scare them away from our lands. They should go back to the forest.

Excellent. It looks like you can be trusted... I also think it's kind of stupid to judge everyone by the actions of one. In your case, that means you shouldn't be judged by the actions of this... Expedition.
Harvest Ripe Ambrosia Blossoms at Blossoming Riverbed

You know that animals started migrating, which means there are too many of them in one place, and too few in another.

And now Ambrosia is ready to be harvested at Blossoming Riverbed near the roots of the Great Tree. But scared Strantlers are all over the place now. The blossoms are in danger.

We need to harvest them before the animals eat them.
If we want to restore balance sooner, we must act now.

Darkness is trying to bring confusion into this world, but these attempts are in vain. Life will always find a way. To better understand my lesson, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.
Send the hostile Windrunners to the beginning of the cycle.

Rhubarb is right, the Windrunners get more and more aggressive every day! They have moved closer to the Great Tree and chased the Strantlers here - those creatures are devouring the flowers now... As you can see... At this rate, every single animal and plant in our forest will be driven from their homes.

We need to do something about the Windrunners now. They are more dangerous than scared herbivores. Most importantly, we need to figure out what's causing them to behave that way...

Those poor things! These unfortunate creatures are looking for salvation in the healing water, but it's not helping...

But why? Is there nothing we can do to help them? I'll look for answers in the forest where they came from. Perhaps I'll find the source of their sickness.

Help Reed for now - I'll be back later.
Send the hostile Windrunners to the beginning of the cycle in the Strantler Meadow

Unfortunately, the Windrunners get more and more aggressive every day. They have moved closer to the Great Tree and chased the Strantlers here. At this rate, every single animal and plant in our forest will be driven from their homes.

We need to do something about the Windrunners. They are more dangerous than scared herbivores. I ask you to deal with them, since they left the area they were supposed to stay in. We have no choice but to exterminate them, sending them back to the beginning of the cycle!
Everyone has their place and their boundaries which should not be crossed.
Alas, sometimes there is no other way out. Death is part of the cycle, just like life. To better understand my lesson, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.
Meet with Waterlily to the east of the Great Tree and go to the forest.

What's going on in our forests? I keep getting news of new problems. I'm sure the reason is you. Or rather, this Expedition of yours... Before you appeared in our world, we'd lived in harmony with all the creatures that dwell here...

Now the animals are anxious... You managed to deal with the Strantlers, but what about the Windrunners? They are much more dangerous.

Go with Waterlily there and decide what to do.
There are more and more of them... Who? Just look down!
Gather plants for the special potion for your hunt.

Great and mighty is the Treebor, the strongest creature in our forest... Even the Windrunners and Swearwolves are scared of it. It wanders the forest like its own domain...

The only way to deal with it is to work together with several hunters.

Before each of our hunts, we perform special rituals, asking for the All-Mother's blessing. The Treebor is her creation, after all...

We need special leaves so we can brew a potion for the ritual. I suppose it's nothing unusual for you - just collect the leaves, and I will do the rest.
We can't begin the hunt without the sap of these plants.
Meet Clover and Mint. They will help us hunt.
Gather plants for the rituals in the Strantler Meadow

There are many similarities between war and hunting. Therefore, we will follow our traditions, but we will need your help to prepare. Have you ever collected leaves in the Strantler Meadow?

You will need to repeat this simple task again. After brewing a special potion, our hunters will be ready to hunt this unusual prey! And may the All-Mother punish these aliens!
Great, thank you for the leaves. It will be a glorious hunt...
Gather plants for the hunters' rituals in the Strantler Meadow

Before every hunt, my Children perform special rituals, asking for my blessing. I think you can give them the help they need.

They need special leaves to brew a potion for the ritual. I suppose it's nothing unusual for you - just collect the leaves, and they will do the rest.
They can't begin the hunt without the sap of these plants.
The gods don't need rituals, but believers do. To better understand my lesson, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.
With the help of Reed and Mint, obtain the Treebor's sap in battle, then defeat it.

Look, that's one of the strongest creatures in the forest down there.

A magnificent and dangerous creature - its beauty is in its might. The Treebors are the biggest inhabitants of our forests. Only the Tree Herders come close.

In this fight, you will know the Treebor's strength, and it will know yours. The Treebor will grant us its strength and rage, and you will take that from it.

I'll tell you how to do it.

I saw the fight. It was a great hunt. Now you know the Treebor's strength, and it knows yours. All its brethren in the valley will recognize you and your allies. We learn quickly, Child of Sarn. Thank you for this lesson.

Now listen - this is what I've learned...

Rage will make its strength fill its veins. Each drop of its sap that falls on the ground is priceless - collect them.

But even in rage, there should be balance, otherwise the sap of the beast will be filled not with strength, but with madness. Don't let the rage of the Treebor dissipate, but don't let it go berserk either.
h: So we'll make it angry - then what?

t:
We need to survive the fight. The Treebor is merciless - if you fall, it will trample you.

Mint can protect you. If you fall, give her a sign, and the forest charms will protect you.

When the Treebor is weakened, we need to wait until it gets distracted and drops its guard. Then we can finish it off. At the right moment, give the command to Clover. His final blow will be precise and merciful, sending the beast to the beginning of the cycle.

Is your heart ready?
h: I'll collect the sap - then what?

t: Defeat Hirkalla with her minions and close the portal.

I'm afraid it happened... It's the Old Tribe! They reached our Valley...

I... I can't believe they are here. How could the All-Mother let it happen?

Some time ago, one of the tribes nearby perished. Their Tree was too old to bear fruit, and the Children of that tribe were born sick and weak. Which meant their Tree would die soon.

But they refused to accept their fate! Rejected the laws of the All-Mother... And now... they are here.

They are doing something... wrong... Twisted.

It has never happened before in our world!

We need to stop them!
Kill the members of the Old Tribe in the Twisted Ravine

I've already heard the story of Hirkalla and how she tried to turn the Old Tribe against the All-Mother! A foolish attempt, but the darkness still poses a threat to this valley.

If the defenders leave to fight the Expedition, the Old Tribe may attack again. Which is why we need to prevent that and crush their forces near the Great Tree.

Go to the Twisted Ravine and deal with them.
The time of the Old Tribe has passed.
Darkness has no place in the World of Life, and you have proven that... Sooner or later, we will defeat Hirkalla.

Yes, we will answer your call!

We will bring not just the warriors of our tribes, but also members of those who live in other parts of our world. Everything is in motion, stories and songs about what is happening here are shared throughout Eden, and the Children are ready to throw the invaders out of this world!

Although there are many strange machines on their side, Eden itself is on ours. The Children are fearless and not afraid of death.
h: Are you willing to aid us?

t:
So the time has come. We'll go to our tribes and summon those who have arrived!

The invaders believed that this land will submit to them, but we will that we can protect our world!

Report our decision to Waterlily.
h: We are ready to set out!

t: The All-Mother sees everything. She warned us that you would come.
Kill the members of the Old Tribe in the Twisted Ravine

Some time ago, one of the tribes that lived near the Great Tree perished. Their Tree was too old to bear fruit, and the Children of that tribe were born sick and weak. Which meant their Tree would die soon. Alas, their fear of death was too strong. They fought against their fate and rejected my laws.

Now these mad creatures attack our part of the forest, steal our Ambrosia, and hurt my other Children. We must stop them and remind them that immortality does not exist.

The Old Children decided to call upon the forces of Darkness. You proved that the Darkness can't help anyone. To better understand my lesson, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.

These creatures... They are not from this world! But they are different from you, too...

It can't be... Unbelievable...

They are... Nihaz's servants! They are here, in Eden! How did they find our world?!

This goddess... Hirkalla. Darkness incarnate! I can't believe it... So it wasn't the Old Tribe's decision to turn against the All-Mother. Hirkalla incited them!

This changes everything. You need to tell the All-Mother and show her this... piece of rot. We are helpless against this evil, but I'm sure she'll think of a way! Hurry. We'll stay here in case they come back.
I see my lessons did you some good. Don't worry about the Darkness, it's deceptive... Follow the path I have shown you, and you will see what caused this.

Those who sent you here must be worried about you. Do not keep them waiting.

I make no secret of what you have learned here. Tell them everything - perhaps they will make the right choice? I can only hope they will.

I suspect she is one of the sorceresses that started drinking dragon blood to become immortal?

Oh, Children of Sarn, you are such... children. You have no idea what transpires outside your world, but your self-importance is boundless.

Catherina does not need my lessons, but her pride will do her an ill turn.

Oh yeah?

Perhaps we could use this... If Nihaz is a problem for the All-Mother, she might help Sarnaut - the enemy of my enemy is my friend, right?

Try to explain to her that we're on the same side. Yes, we harvest the Ambrosia, but only because we desperately need it, and if those rotten things are a threat to her, we could help her fight them. We have quite an arsenal here, after all.
Come in! Do you copy? I repeat. Do you copy? Can you hear me? Tep take this rusty thing! Do you copy? Come in!

h: I read you loud and clear!

t: Come in! Do you copy? As you can see, this is a multipurpose device for long distance communication.
Find ten flowers with memories of the Great War.

I know that Nihaz told you a lot about the Great War, but there are things he kept from you. If you want to know how it happened, you will have to go back to the very beginning. Why were Sarn and Nihaz fighting? How did my daughter end up in Sarnaut? How did everything around us come to be?

I transferred everything to the memory of my Trees, and to this Great Tree. Its roots are deep, and from time to time a flower sprouts on it, bearing images of the past. I don't want to tell you everything at once. You will go on a journey through my forest, and you will find these flowers. You will learn what happened. You will hear the whole truth about what happened.
Have you found all the flowers?
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
Eliminate the Strantlers that settled at the base.

What's up with this base? Where is the security, where is the staff?

It's a nightmare... And these deer roam everywhere...

You know, we deliberately set up a second base a little further from the Gates, so it would be more quiet here. At first it was like that... however, the war has clearly reached this place, too.

You need to figure out what happened and where everyone is... But first, get rid of these pests, I don't want them to break anything. Perhaps we can restore something.
Wonderful. These cute creatures will no longer interfere with my work.
Eliminate the Strantlers in the Green Pigweed

For the Penelope base to continue its work, we need to get rid of the creatures that are wandering around the place. The Strantlers in particular - those impudent hoofed creatures, stupid and stubborn.

Apparently our buildings are in their way, I can't find any other explanation for why they keep coming back.

Either way, you need to reduce their population before they damage our equipment. Regrets would be unwarranted here - if they don't understand why they should stay away, we will make it clear to them! Get to work!
Great job! Now you need to make sure these stupid deer remember the lesson! Perhaps tomorrow we will repeat what we did today!
Repair the Mechanoid sentries around the base.

"Penelope" is named after the first victim of this world who died from the fangs and thorns of the local flora and fauna.

But I doubt this victim will be the last. It is important for us to avoid irretrievable losses. So our main fighting force is the Mechanoids based on the Xadaganian schematics. Cheap and easy to produce. It would be worse to lose my knights.

These combat Mechanoids are well-armed, I wonder what could go wrong?

It looks like the forest won the battle here - there are a lot of broken sentries around the base. First of all, they need to be repaired so they can continue to keep order.

Fortunately, their modular construction makes it easy to replace faulty parts as long as you have spares.
Local deer are beasts if they did that to our machines. Or the machines weren't that great to begin with.
Wonderful. Though the quiet of the forest was better than this clanging.
Repair the Mechanoid sentries at the Penelope base

Our combat bases are guarded by the Mechanoids based on Xadaganian schematics. They are cheap and easy to produce, but we don't have an infinite supply of them. So it would be nice if you could repair them.

It's easy to do. Their modular construction makes it easy to replace faulty parts as long as you have spares.

I ask you to go there and repair as many Mechanoids as you can.
Wonderful! We repaired our equipment and saved our resources. We can even give bonuses to the staff!
Read the remaining reports at the base and complete the tasks indicated in them.

We need to figure out why there's no one here.

I don't think people disappeared completely without a trace, but to reconstruct the course of events, you need to understand what happened here recently.

Herbert and Elena had to do certain research, which means they had to keep records. Find them and read them. It should help us figure out where to look for the missing members of the Expedition.
Well, we've learned some things, but it's still hard to say where they are.

January 9, 1022. Herbert de Vevre's notes.

We started researching the local flora. I compared the samples collected at the main base and here. The difference is visible to the naked eye. It seems that the flora at the Gates very quickly acquired the properties necessary for defense and even offense. It is quite curious that the plants seem to interact with each other, as if trying to work out a "single tactic" against us.
h: Read the first page of the report on Eden flora

t: These are notes from the first report

It looks like Herbert wanted to collect pollen samples before everyone on the base died of allergies. If we want to avoid that, you need to collect spore samples and take them to Catherina before it's too late.
I understand, but we need it. For science.

Wonderful!

I will analyze it and try to find a remedy for this allergy. I don't need runny noses around here. One of the Zharova sisters, Beliana, was always sniffling when flowers were blooming on Umoir. Trust me, it's the most annoying sound.
Pick poisonous mushrooms in the Green Pigweed

If we want to understand this world, we need to continue studying it. Despite your contacts with the Children and the All-Mother, the local fauna and flora still continue to give us trouble.

What's bad is that they change very quickly. It means we need to keep developing new antidotes for local toxins and antiallergic drugs.

For that, I need samples. Right now I need samples of mushrooms. Gather some for me.
I understand, but we need it. For science.
Wonderful! One of the main properties of the local plants and animals is that tomorrow they will be completely different. So I might need new samples tomorrow.
Eliminate Sunchews and Stumpers near the base.

It looks like Elena wants to eliminate animals near the Penelope base. We should address this issue if we want to keep using the base, otherwise even the Strantlers' invasion will seem like a walk in the park. We must eliminate some of the creatures.
That's not a bad idea. The fewer beasts, the better.

Elena was right. These creatures breed like rabbits.

I wouldn't want one of them to break in in the middle of the night, completely wrecking the place. And I'd happily burn down the weeds with my own hands.

Since you've already figured it out, I'd better get down to more intellectually challenging work.
Eliminate the Stumpers in the Green Pigweed

Stumpers are perhaps the most dangerous creatures on Eden. They're strong and almost invulnerable to our firearms. With their population as big as it is now, we can't feel safe in this world. We need to reduce their numbers.

Why don't you take care of it? I'll show you where our scouts found the greatest number of these creatures.

Kill as many as you can! No pity! Stumpers will surely show none to us!
The fewer of those creatures, the better.
I believe the local animals have been breeding faster than ever since your arrival at Eden. Felix suggests eliminating them before they eliminate us!
These are notes from the second report
Collect new thorn samples from under your feet.

The thorns that pop out from the ground might be part of the Great Tree's root system. Apparently Herbert and Elena need to study them for their work on the Tree's defensive mutations. Collect fresh thorns to see how they transform over time.
Try to survive, for the sake of Tensess!

I've read the report. They might be right. Therefore, if we want to win this battle once and for all, we have to destroy the mighty Great Tree. I hope we can avoid this. For now, let's stick to the traditional methods and see if they work.

Hand over the thorns. I need to do some research. Perhaps, we can find something that can resist them and make mechanoids' armor impervious to them.
Collect new thorn samples in the Green Pigweed when they appear under your feet.

I'd like to study new underground thorns that might be part of the Great Tree's root system. We need to understand how each part of the local symbiosis works with the rest of the system. This is the only way to confront dangers of this world.

I need fresh thorn samples to see how they transformed since the last time.
Try to survive, for the sake of Tensess!
Wonderful! Extreme changeability is one of the main features of local plants animals. They evolve by the day. That's why I might need more samples tomorrow.
Find and catch intruders on the Penelope base.

Hey, listen up, yo.

We're watched. Don't turn around! Hush. We've been watched since we left the previous base. There are two of them. I tried to get into their heads but couldn't. They're protected by something big, like a thundercloud over the sun. I just couldn't do it!

They're still watching us so catching them won't be a walk in the park. But I have an idea, heh. I can distract them with your phantom while you're sneaking from behind.

You're cool with that, right?
What are you and the orc plotting?
Green aliens? If I hadn't read Herbert's journal, I would have thought that you got sunstroke. I hope, our visitors are alive.
Talk to the locals, then talk to Catherina.

Just look at that! The elusive locals. Wow. I've never seen them so close. Our previous encounters ended up in shooting. It's a good thing that Felix isn't here today. At least, this time we can talk for real.

Ask them what they want. And I need to know where my people from the base are.

I'm sure you three can make it. I'm counting on Eurial in particular. She alone is smarter than you two dumbheads, you and Skulnar. As you know, you don't have much time. Ivan and Felix will get bored at some point, and then they'll knock the Children of All-Mother into tomorrow! You need to hurry.

I'll stay here to look after Penelope, continue Herbert and Elena's research, and wait for some news from you.
Mount the Windsower, get to the Great Tree, and deserve the right to talk to All-Mother.

I knew you would agree to come with me.

All-Mother has chosen you for a reason. All tribes of Eden used to live in peace until the Darkness came and the Old Tribe went to war against the others.

Juniper predicted your arrival but no one believed him. And now you're here. You've come a long way, but you don't know much about this world. You have a lot to learn. But I believe that you're destined to save our world.

Our Windsowers are waiting for you upstairs whenever you're ready.
Outsiders! What do you want in Eden?

You will pay for what you've done! I've been watching you! I know everything about you! Every little thing!

All-Mother awaits. Her sentence will be swift, just, and final.
Face All-Mother's trial and defend your right to exist.

You're relying too much on your invulnerability. You think you're immortal. But this is our world. Here you're exposed and vulnerable.

The likes of you realized that the end was inevitable and begged for mercy.

Are you ready to end your journey here? Once and for all?

Go ahead. We shall meet at the end of your way. This is where you shall reply for the deeds of your people and yourself.

Ah. A long-awaited "savior" from another world.

Don't flatter yourself, I don't really need your aid. I've seen worlds being born and destroyed. You're nothing but a flash. A short instant of my life.

But this young child may be right. You might be not completely hopeless.

I don't know what was the God of Darkness's concept behind your creation, but I'm sure you have no idea how it all began. He didn't tell you, did he?

My lessons will teach you the real purpose of Being.
Ask the Expedition members about Eden.

Greetings.

I didn't expect you here, although it's only logical. Connection with Sarnaut has long been lost. I suppose, you were curious what was going on here. We're alright, as you can see.

Catherina and Felix's operation is going according to the plan. We settled here, set up a base, and started ambrosia mining.

You can talk to the Expedition members to get a full picture.

I suggest you start with the medical unit, processing workshop, and the production hall. This should suffice.
Our Expedition was thrown together by the bureaucratic Imperial chaos and crazy League voluntarism.
Now you know what's going on here. Remember that apart from Klavdia's followers, there are plenty of Felix and Catherina's people.

Quite well, thank you. Did I say, "quite well?" Absolutely perfect!

Too perfect, in fact. This world... how should I put it... is unusual. One thing you ought to remember: the Purgatory, Servants of Tensess, and the lay brother, they're all in Sarnaut. There are no such things here. Death here is permanent.

Thankfully, it's not that easy to die here. There was this knucklehead, stupid enough to reach out to grab something from under a running saw. Lost his arm in a second. I thought he was done with. You know what happened? He regrew a working limb! Over a week's time!

But that's not all! Then wild beasts came, and one of the guys lost his head.

You won't believe it either. He regrew the head! As good as new. Blank memory, of course, but it's nothing, really.

I had a cripple leg back on Sarnaut. It hurt like hell. It hurt so bad that I had to take psy-spice to kill the pain. Guess what? The pain is gone! I can run a thousand in this world!

We have to soak the Arisen in formaldehyde. Otherwise they risk becoming normal people, hehe. On the other hand, old wounds remain unchanged.

But don't worry, there are reliable ways to die even here. For example, if you're poisoned or ripped to pieces. We've lost a lot of our guys. Be careful with local creatures.
h: How are you doing in the strange new world?

t: Greetings. What seems to be the problem? Headache? Diarrhea? Shaky hands?

We have another problem.

Let me give you a hint. Everything is growing here. Stick a twig in the ground, and it'll spring roots and leaves. It would have been great if not for the local plants that fling their seeds everywhere. They're carried with the wind, stick to your shoes, land on mechanoids. We're trying to keep the place sterile but we can't get rid of them completely. The problem is that they grow! Fast!

You miss one sprout, and in no time, it uproots and walks around the base, breaking everything in its way. We must inspect and weed this place all the time!

I can't be on duty 24/7. I need your help. It will give you an idea of what awaits you here.

Walk around the base and weed out all Sunchews.
A sunchew grew in our shithouse once. The base was paralyzed.
Sunchews are a small sample of this world for you. Other creatures may impress even a seasoned botanist.

I'll be brief, chief! There are enemies all over the base! But not the ones Felix was talking about... The real ones!

We have an invasion of these Triffids... Sunchews! They are quite scary! Hideous weed!

Not only do they propagate at a wild rate, but you can’t grab them with your bare hands - you'll get nasty burns! Already lost a troop of Orcs there, chief. The nurses are running out of tissues, mourning them.

But I know you're not afraid of any burns. You can handle them, chief.
I hear they even tried making moonshine from them. So? It's biomass!
Good job, chief. The base is almost clear, there's nothing to fear now.
Get rid of the Sunchews at the Gates base

Have you realized where you are? Local plants fling their seeds everywhere. They stick to your shoes, land on mechanoids. We're trying to keep the base sterile but we can't get rid of them completely. If a seed lands, it instantly sprouts.

You miss one, and in no time, a Sunchew uproots and walks around the base, breaking everything in its way.

Your task is to get rid of the weed!
A sunchew grew in our shithouse once. The base was paralyzed.

If I could, I would tell Felix to burn down the forest to solve the Sunchew problem once and for all. Since it's impossible, we'll have to be extra careful! The enemy is waiting for us to drop our guard... And our losses keep mounting.
Escort Felix and Catherina to the base.

Excellent! By the order of the senior base officer on duty, you are now a member of the Expedition.

You see, Felix and Catherina haven't arrived yet. They've been out scouting. Should be back soon.

You need to meet them by the gates. You might have to get rid of uninvited guests. The gates of our base are a ripe target for everyone out there.
I think our base is under attack. To the cannons! They're right on the walls.

These things are getting more and more aggressive. Felix thinks that the locals let them out to attack us. Catherina is sure that they've got a hive mind.

On the downside, we have to kill them all. There's no other way.

It's good to know that I'm no longer responsible for the base. I wouldn't want to lose it while Catherina is away.

I suppose, the Expedition leaders would want to talk to you in person. We divided the jobs according to our talents. Felix fights and protects, Catherina studies and invents, and Ivan Chelezny pays for everything.

Each of them has something to say. Go to the headquarters and report your arrival.
They want to see you as soon as possible.
Remember, you must talk to me and ask for my approval before you do anything at all. I am the Expedition leader. I decide what's best.
Destroy local animals and birds around the base.

Plants and animals of Eden are real terrorists. They can't stop beating up each other. There are beasts of every color: armored, venomous, clawed, tentacled... A mixture of animals and plants. I'm talking about everything that can crawl, fly, or just sit there.

There's a new abomination every day. And all of them love hanging around our base. Here's my order: kill as many predators out there as you can.
Report the progress of my task.
The fewer of them, the easier. I wish they didn't reproduce so fast. We could try and burn down their breeding spots.
Eliminate the local animals and birds around the base.

I'll be brief, chief! Here's the thing: there are too many beasts around the base. It would be fine, but our enemies use them to spy on us.

So if we want to launch an attack, we must first secure the area around the base. Everyone thinks so, but no one wants to do anything, so they decided to task you with it. Well, you are a hero, so you can fight the beasts, surely.
So how are our birds and animals?
Great, boss! While we can't get rid of them entirely, we can at least reduce their numbers...

I don't think, I act! Let's blow something up, okay?

So many new impressions! So many new ideas! It's time to do something! My hands are itching! I need to create! Ooooh, just give me a workshop and a heap of nuts and bolts! I know I can come up with something! Just look at all the saws lying around! Imagination running wild!

Come on, go and find Catherina! Tell her I'm ready for action!
h: What do you think about the new world?

t: Woah, look at all these new constructions! I wonder where they found the time for it.

Hello there, chief! I've always wanted to blow everything up, yeah. You and Catherina have interesting ideas! I love it!

Well, I'll do it. I'll build you a mana bomb in a couple of days, if need be...

But the Ambrosia part - now there's a problem.
h: Ask about creating an Ambrosia mana bomb

t:
In short, we need this crystalline concentrate... But this is not Suslanger, there are no crystals here. So we need to distill liquid Ambrosia into crystalline form - and this requires time and a lot of this liquid Ambrosia.

And that's another problem. Those Children are vicious. They don't let us collect the Ambrosia. They're hitting us on all fronts, yeah.

If you want Ambrosia to flow through the pipeline, then you must inspire the soldiers with your own example. How?

Complete a few of my tasks, and we'll win, you'll see. As soon as everything is ready, come see me.

By the way, lest you think I'm sitting around twiddling my thumbs here - you'll be able to see the progress yourself. The more you do, the sooner it will be finished.

Yes, chief. Almost everything is ready, but... one component is missing. Yes, that always seems to be the case.

True, but this time I know who has it. After all, we have cameras all over the place, so no one can get through undetected.

If they had worked at Gates-3, then no Alice would have been able to steal the Chronophone, and you wouldn't have had to wallow in the desert.
Great, chief! This is exactly what we need! It’s good that you did it quickly, because I’m being rushed here, too.

Come on, chief, I need more Ambrosia. I'm telling you - if you want Ambrosia to flow through the pipeline, then you need to inspire the soldiers with your own example. Complete my tasks, and we'll win.
Eliminate the Swearwolves and Disbeleaves near the Gates base

Alas, every beast outside the base wants only one thing: to get inside and destroy everything. They keep circling the perimeter. It's the only thing that separates the wilderness and our civilization!

The local predators are the most dangerous. Swearwolves are fast, cunning, and deadly. Disbeleaves are giant birds. You won't see them before they start pecking your eyeballs out.

There's only one way to put an end to it: ruthless elimination. Your task is to clean up the area around the base before we lose more people.
How is it going with my request?
Well done. The fewer of them, the easier. We'll kill them all sooner or later. In the meanwhile, we'll have to do some good work for the sake of Sarnaut.

Felix loves to solve problems with brute force. However, I believe there's something else behind the aggression of the local floral fauna.

You see, during the first days after our arrival the local animals and plants showed zero aggression.

It started a little later. Our mining routes were blocked by a herd of migrating mammals. We were compelled to use weapons.

Later on, it got so bad that we had to build a wall and secure it with cannons.

Day after day the animals and plants evolved, becoming more and more dangerous.

I need to study plants around our base. Bring me several mushroom samples. The symbiosis they form with other species is quite unique.
I could wait more, but you'd better hurry.

Alright, let's see what you got. Luckily, we can extract the life essence, or whatever they call it.

I can already see the change... They've grown some new prickles and hairs. I hope you were wearing gloves while gathering them. I wouldn't want you to lose your hands.
Collect mushroom samples near the Gates base

The Forest has changed the most around the Gates base, and it's puzzling. Apparently, the local fauna identifies us as threat and strikes back. I must say, the pace of their evolution is amazing.

In a matter of days they can produce new types of toxins or grow new prickles that pierce through any material.

I need to study them all the time to come up with relevant protection. Get me more mushroom samples. It looks like they contain tissues of every living object around here.
I could wait more, but you'd better hurry.
Wonderful! Extreme changeability is one of the main features of local plants animals. They evolve by the day. That's why I might need more samples tomorrow.
Fix the harvester outside the base.

Our Expedition is still a huge risk. A financial risk, of course. Catherina and Felix couldn't care less how much the Expedition costs, but the Tycoon Council will hold me accountable for every penny spent here.

Even though there are plenty of spare parts for new mechanoids in our warehouses, we must cut corners wherever we can. Let's fix what was broken.

Like, for instance, our harvester. A universal resource collector and a moving processing plant that turns wood into ambrosia.

Try and fix it. You should find plenty of spare parts around the base.

Constant losses and growing costs take the wind out of my sails. Only future profits from ambrosia sales can warm this old heart.
Every second that our harvesters stand idly is a lost profit. Hurry.
The harvester is up and running once again? Excellent. The sounds of its cogs and gears, screeching saws, roaring power units are music to my ears. They make me richer my the minute!
Fix the Harvester outside the base.

I'll be brief, chief! Everything is fine, the troops are ready to march and die for our cause, but there is one more thing we need to do - fix one of our Harvesters. The damned Children keep trying to break them like they have nothing better to do. And now they brought their elephant and destroyed the machine, and the parts are scattered everywhere.

You need to collect them. It's not difficult - they were designed in a way so even a dumb Orc could fit the square into the square and the circle into the circle. Though I hear they still mix them up, but you are smarter than them, boss. You can handle it. At least on the second try.
The Harvester is a great machine. I'll get one of those for my summer house. After the war, I mean.
Wow, you really are unmatched, chief. A Jack of all trades. I believe the construction of the mana bomb is almost finished.
